policies.title: British Virgin Islands: PRC passport tourism and business visa waiver
policies.summary: The Government of the Virgin Islands visa-requirements document says China requires a visa only for purposes other than tourism and business, excluding Hong Kong SAR; the ordinary-passport tourist baseline is therefore visa-free.
conditions: This is limited to mainland China (CN) for tourism or business. The source expressly excludes Hong Kong SAR, which has no separate project passport code.
No stay duration, admission guarantee, entry count, eVisa, ETA, visa-on-arrival, special/diplomatic passport, work, residence, transit or third-country-document condition is normalized.

The older Tourism Board schedule still labels China visa-required as at December 2019. The later government visa-requirements document is used for this narrow present mapping; no broad schedule conclusion is drawn.

policies.title: British Virgin Islands: Taiwan passport tourism visa waiver
policies.summary: The Government of the Virgin Islands visa-requirements document says Taiwan requires a visa only for purposes other than tourism and business; the ordinary-passport tourist baseline is visa-free.
conditions: This mapping is confined to tourist entry by a Taiwan passport holder. The source explicitly limits the non-visa treatment to tourism and business rather than extending it to work, residence, transit or other categories.
No stay duration, admission guarantee, entry count, eVisa, ETA, visa-on-arrival, special/diplomatic passport or third-country-document condition is normalized.
The Tourism Board repeats a 2012 Taiwanese passport waiver, but this policy relies on the later Government visa-requirements document for the exact visitor-purpose split.

policies.title: British Virgin Islands: nationals of Guyana visa exemption
policies.summary: The 2024 Cabinet statutory instrument amends the Visa Exemption Order by adding nationals of Guyana.
conditions: The order is a nationality exemption from the BVI visa requirement. It does not establish a duration, admission guarantee, work right, residence right, eVisa, ETA, or visa-on-arrival route.
This classification is limited to the ordinary short-tourist baseline; special documents and other purposes remain outside scope.

policies.title: British Virgin Islands: full British citizen passport short visitor entry
policies.summary: Current UK Foreign Office travel advice says a visitor on a full British citizen passport can visit BVI without a visa for up to one month.
conditions: This mapping is limited to the ordinary full British citizen passport represented by GB in this catalog and to the one-month visitor scope stated by the UK Foreign Office.
It must not be generalized to British Overseas Territories citizenship, BVI belonger status, other British nationality classes, residence, work, transit, or special documents.
The online embarkation card mentioned by the advice is an arrival form; this source does not call it an ETA or visa.
